reel_voice_alt.note: owner rule: Google Charon reads EVERY reel, ONLY inside Google's free allowance (1 million characters a month); the code stops at 700,000 (safety margin: some usage records can be lost when posting jobs save at the same time), then Midhun (edge-tts) until the 1st; Midhun also whenever Google fails. Never paid. Needs secret GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY

prime_time.note: owner rule: non-urgent reels wait for the high-view times (9-12 and 18-21:30 IST; re-check with this page's own insights); urgent news posts at once; nothing is ever dropped - a reel that has waited max_wait_hours posts at once

reel_punch_note: every reel opens with a spoken punch line (yellow number + headline) while the big headline is on screen

reach.place_tags_note: Malayalam stem -> hashtag. Stems stop before a final chillu (ർ ൽ ൾ) because it changes with suffixes; longer names first (the first match wins).
